map.根据传递功率、主动轮转速与传动比，推荐 V 带型号、最小带轮直径、带速、中心距与: Recommend V belt type, minimum pulley diameter, belt speed, center distance and reference length based on transmitted power, driving pulley speed and transmission ratio
map.依据传递功率 P、主动轮转速 n₁ 与传动比 i 选带型与带轮直径: Select belt type and pulley diameter from transmitted power P, driving pulley speed n1 and transmission ratio i
map.由传递功率 P、主动轮转速 n₁ 与传动比 i 选型，依据标准带轮直径系列计算带: From transmitted power P, driving pulley speed n1 and transmission ratio i, select based on standard pulley diameter series to compute belt speed, count and center distance, with tension and verification suggestions.
map.💡 带速 v=πd₁n₁/(60×1000)；从动轮 d₂=i×d₁；中心距 a: Belt speed v = pi d1 n1 / (60 times 1000); driven pulley d2 = i times d1; center distance a is approximately (0.7 to 2) times (d1 + d2); belt length L = 2 a + pi (d1 + d2) / 2 + (d2 minus d1) squared / (4 a).
map.V 带型号：Y/Z/A/B/C/D/E，功率越大型号越大: V belt types: Y / Z / A / B / C / D / E, larger power needs larger type
map.带速一般 5~25 m/s 为宜，最佳 15~20 m/s: Belt speed is generally 5 to 25 m/s, optimum 15 to 20 m/s
map.小带轮包角应 ≥120°，传动比一般 ≤7: Small pulley wrap angle should be greater than or equal to 120 deg, transmission ratio generally less than or equal to 7
map.📚 深度解析：皮带传动选型（带型/带轮/中心距/带长）: In-depth: Belt Drive Selection (belt type / pulley / center distance / belt length)
map.传动设计：由功率、转速与传动比选 V 带型号与带轮: Transmission design: select V belt type and pulley from power, speed and ratio
map.带速校核：带速过高时自动放大带轮直径: Belt speed check: automatically enlarge pulley when belt speed too high
map.布置规划：给出中心距范围与基准长度，便于订货: Layout planning: give center distance range and reference length for ordering
map.算法：按传递功率查表选带型（Y≤0.5、Z≤2、A≤5、B≤15、C≤40、D≤: Algorithm: select belt type by transmitted power table (Y less than or equal to 0.5, Z less than or equal to 2, A less than or equal to 5, B less than or equal to 15, C less than or equal to 40, D less than or equal to 75, E less than or equal to 200 kW) and take the minimum pulley diameter; small pulley diameter takes the first standard series (20, 22.4, 25, ..., 800) greater than or equal to the minimum; belt speed = pi times d1 times n1 / 60000, if greater than 25 m/s increase pulley diameter step by step until qualified; large pulley = the first standard series greater than or equal to d1 times ratio; actual ratio = d2 / d1; recommended center distance 0.7 (d1 + d2) to 2 (d1 + d2), recommended value 0.9 (d1 + d2); reference length L = 2 a + pi (d1 + d2) / 2 + (d2 minus d1) squared / (4 a).
map.例：5.5kW、1450rpm、传动比 2.5 → 选 B 型（最小轮径 125: Example: 5.5 kW, 1450 rpm, ratio 2.5 gives B type (minimum wheel diameter 125 mm), d1 = 125 mm, belt speed 9.49 m/s, d2 = 315 mm, actual ratio 2.52, center distance range 308 to 880 mm, recommended 396 mm, reference length 1505.9 mm. If 22 kW, 960 rpm, ratio 3 gives C type (minimum wheel diameter 200 mm), d1 = 200 mm, belt speed 10.05 m/s, d2 = 630 mm, actual ratio 3.15, recommended center distance 747 mm, reference length 2859.6 mm.
map.因为带轮直径必须取标准系列值（如 312.5 取到 315），实际比会略有偏差。: Because the pulley diameter must take standard series values (e.g. 312.5 takes 315), the actual ratio deviates slightly. For applications with strict ratio requirements, adjust the d1 / d2 combination to approach the target, or switch to a synchronous belt.
map.基准长度怎么选配？: How to select the reference length?
map.算出 L 后按该带型的长度系列取最接近的标准值，再反算实际中心距。通常优先取相近: After computing L, take the closest standard value from the length series of that belt type, then back-calculate the actual center distance. Usually prefer the closest and slightly smaller one, leaving adjustment margin for installation and tensioning.
